paper.journal: Progress in Natural Science: Materials International
paper.title: Preparation of ultrahigh surface area porous carbons templated using zeolite 13X for enhanced hydrogen storage

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-extraction of Tables 1-2 + text): 36 numeric cells, 0 disputes; micropore fractions re-derived (85-88% SA, 71-75% V) match the text. uptake_type by exact-word rule confirmed: the 7.3 wt% (FA-ZTC1, Table 1) is the 'total hydrogen uptake capacity' (Summary) and the extra FA-ZTC1 6.2 wt% is the 'excess hydrogen uptake'; the 9.22 wt% Langmuir extrapolation and the zeolite-13X template correctly excluded. total-excess=1.1 wt% matches the computed compressed-gas term (physical cross-check). Buoyancy correction confirmed described -> calibration point by hand -> all rows Tier A. No changes.

notes.type: uptake_type=total (exact-word rule): the Summary states 'The templated carbons have a total hydrogen uptake capacity of up to 7.3 wt% at 20 bar and 77 K, excess hydrogen uptake of 6.2 wt%' -- the 7.3 (=FA-ZTC1, Table 1 column) is the total; so the Table 1/2 'H2 uptake' column is total for every sample
notes.excessrow: FA-ZTC1 additionally has a stated excess uptake of 6.2 wt% at 20 bar/77 K (section 3.5, Summary); recorded as a second row (uptake_type=excess), mirroring the HYC-0031 total/excess pairing
notes.exclude: the projected maximum TOTAL capacity of 9.22 wt% for FA-ZTC1 is a Langmuir extrapolation (section 3.5) and is excluded as modelled/extrapolated
notes.method: H2 by gravimetric analysis (IGA, Hiden); 99.9999% H2 further purified by a molecular-sieve filter; degassed 200 C at 1e-10 bar 4-6 h; uptake corrected for buoyancy of system and samples using carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 and adsorbed-H2 density 0.04 g/cm3 -> calibration point by hand (buoyancy correction described, tiering doc l.24)
notes.sa: surface_area_method=BET (P/P0 0.06-0.22); SBET and the parenthetic micropore surface area from Table 1/2; total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0=0.99 (single-point) with its parenthetic micropore volume; pore_volume_method=unspecified (single-point total; corpus convention for single-point totals)
notes.psd: pore size is a unimodal NLDFT PSD maximum at 1.2 nm (0.6/1.2 nm bimodal after compaction); recorded as a note not as average_pore_diameter (a PSD mode is not a mean; HYC-0042 ZTC precedent left pore diameter empty)
notes.ztc: zeolite-13X templated carbon by furfuryl-alcohol liquid impregnation + ethylene CVD at 700 C, then 900 C under Ar; zeolite removed by 10% HF 24 h then reflux in 36.5% HCl 6 h (purification); class=templated_carbon, synthesis_method=template_synthesis (HYC-0042 ZTC precedent)
notes.compact: C5-/C10-FA-ZTC3 are FA-ZTC3 after uniaxial compaction at 5 t (370 MPa) / 10 t (740 MPa); compaction is a post-synthesis mechanical treatment (not activation), noted in the description; textural/H2 data are the post-compaction values (Table 2)
notes.chahine: 77 K, 20 bar (not 1 bar, so the saturation bound applies); FA-ZTC1 total 7.3 wt% at 3332 m2/g: the excess (6.2) is below the ~6.66 wt% Chahine estimate and the total exceeds it only by the compressed-gas term, so physically consistent (no physics override)
